title: Private deployment \u0013 ACME weekly sync (prep & follow-ups)
content:
Meeting: ACME weekly sync  Tue 2026-03-30 (prep notes + follow-ups)
Owner: Samira Patel
Attendees (expected): Liam, Rafaela, Oliver, Maya, ACME infra lead (Ankit), ACME security (Priya)
Goals for this sync:
- Confirm VPC peering + routing changes completed in staging and schedule prod cutover window
- Validate on-prem install progress and outstanding infra work (NFS mounts, KMS connectivity)
- Surface any blockers that would impact the April 6th pilot with ACME dev team

Quick status snapshot (since last week)
- VPC: Peering request accepted, shared route tables in staging; still need to get cross-account SG rules approved by ACME security (Priya). (owner: Liam)
- On-prem install: Bare-metal nodes provisioned by ACME, initial kubelet registration succeeded on 3/5 nodes, failing on node-4 due to disk layout mismatch. (owner: Oliver)
- KMS/HSM: Waiting on ACME to grant our service principal access to the key policy for wrapping/unwrapping secrets. Security review in progress. (owner: Rafaela)
- Observability: Datadog agent image validated, but metrics namespace conventions need alignment (ACME expects team=acme, we send service=redwood). Small config change needed. (owner: Maya)

Milestones (near-term)
- M1 (STAGING VPC complete): target 2026-03-31  deliverable: validated cross-account routing and rule doc. (Liam)
- M2 (ON-PREM BARE METAL READY): target 2026-04-02  deliverable: all nodes registered, kube-proxy healthy. (Oliver)
- M3 (KMS ACCESS GRANTED): target 2026-04-01  deliverable: policy updated + successful test decrypt/encrypt with service principal. (Rafaela)
- M4 (PILOT CUTOVER WINDOW): tentative 2026-04-06  needs signoff from Priya (security) and Ankit (ACME infra).

Open blockers (priority order)
1) Disk layout mismatch on node-4  blocks full cluster readiness. Root cause likely provisioner using LVM config that conflicts with ACME base image partitioning. Next step: Oliver to get remote console access + create repro. ETA: 2026-03-31.
2) KMS key policy missing Redwood service principal  prevents secrets bootstrap for on-prem services. ACME security review queued. Need Priya to approve key policy change. Escalation: Rafaela to ping ACME security lead if no response by 2026-03-31.
3) Cross-account SG rules are flagged by ACME security for additional justification (they require CIDR/global rule justification). We need to provide minimal exposure proof and fallback architecture. Liam to prepare justification doc and example ACLs.

Agenda (15-20 min)
- 0-3 min: Quick check-in and go/no-go on blockers today
- 3-8 min: VPC & routing status (Liam)
- 8-13 min: On-prem node provisioning + disk issue (Oliver)
- 13-17 min: KMS/HSM access + security signoffs (Rafaela + Priya)
- 17-20 min: Pilot cutover timeline and next steps (Samira)

Action items (post-meeting tracking)
- Oliver: Secure remote console for node-4, capture dmesg + partition table, propose remediation (repartition or reprovision). Due 2026-03-31. (high)
- Rafaela: Follow up with Priya (ACME security) on KMS policy approval; draft minimal key policy snippet to share. Due 2026-03-31. (high)
- Liam: Draft SG justification doc and provide a minimally permissive ACL alternative for review. Due 2026-04-01. (medium)
- Maya: Update Datadog config to support ACME namespace conventions; run smoke tests in staging. Due 2026-03-31. (low)
- Samira: Prep cutover checklist and rollback plan, share with ACME and internal SRE. Due 2026-04-02. (high)

Notes-to-self / talking points
- Emphasize that pilot cutover can be shifted by 48-72 hours if ACME security needs more time; prefer to get KMS signoff before any secrets are pushed to on-prem nodes.
- Ask ACME if they can reprovision node-4 from their image store  faster than manual repartitioning? (Ankit might prefer reprovision.)
- Have a fallback plan: if KMS not ready, run pilot in staging only with dev creds and simulated traffic (document limitations).

Link to previous weekly notes: private-deployment-acme-weekly-sync-2026-03-23 (see meeting notes and action item statuses)

Prep checklist for the meeting (what to have ready)
- Liam: route table screenshots + peering confirmation, SG rule diff (prod vs staging)
- Oliver: node-4 logs, kubelet status, repro steps
- Rafaela: draft KMS policy snippet, list of required permissions for Redwood service principal
- Maya: Datadog sample dashboard and test run output
- Samira: cutover checklist + rollback steps, proposed pilot cutover time range (two windows)

Post-meeting follow-up plan
- Send meeting notes + action items within 24 hours (I'll update this doc and push to the shared Drive path)
- Tag owners in the action item tracker (JIRA/Confluence) and request status update before next sync

Misc: keep this doc as the single source for quick reference. Update status lines at top before next sync.
